lgu.meaning: Indicative, relative ordering of the 142 cities and municipalities for planning attention. It is the province estimate re-weighted by PSA 2021 poverty incidence (60%) and 2024 POPCEN population density (40%) inside each province. It is not a measured municipal food-insecurity rate, not an independent municipal forecast and not an official classification (Chapter I, 1.7). The province estimate it starts from has NOT been validated against baselines (E25-E28), so the ranking inherits that status: EXPERIMENTAL.
lgu.method: vulnerability = 0.6 x poverty_norm + 0.4 x density_norm (min-max within province); risk_index = province probability x vulnerability, clamp [0,1], 4 dp; competition ranks, ranked on the unrounded index (E66), ties by PSGC; null probability -> null risk and ranks
lgu.ranked_on: SM (not recommended; no recommended Lead-1 forecast)
